article.title: China’s AI rise: can jobs and education keep pace with the rise of the robots?
article.author: Editor
article.content: China is taking a bold approach to the robotic revolution. As humanoid production grows, CHEN JIAQI reports on how Beijing is expanding social safety nets and pioneering new career pathways to ensure technology uplifts rather than displaces working people. The post China’s AI rise: can jobs and education keep pace with the rise of the robots? appeared first on MR Online .
